look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Single fan-shaped leaves with repeatedly FORKING (dichotomous) veins, often notched at tip; leaves cluster on short spur shoots. Female trees bear fleshy-coated naked seeds, not berries or drupes.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Deciduous ornamental tree, crown narrow to spreading with age.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Simple fan-shaped long-petioled leaves with dichotomously forked veins; notch variable; short spur shoots often carry clusters.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Gymnosperm: male pollen cones and female stalked ovules; no true flowers.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Fleshy-coated seeds borne on female trees, not enclosed in a fruit ovary.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Short spur shoots plus longer extension shoots; rough furrowed bark with age.
